cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: C1 pattern - Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Coco-Glucoside #3 and Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4, refatting Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #6 and Glyceryl Oleate #8; no second anionic or reset route/intent.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful cationic system (Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #9) plus emollient/waxy payload lipid Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #6 (§6 reviewed row), refatter Glyceryl Oleate #8 and humectants (Erythritol #11, Glycerin #12, Panthenol #13, hyaluronates #17/#18). No silicone or fatty alcohol, so not clearly multiple complementary systems at C2 strength.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Lipid + polymer + humectants could be read as multiple complementary systems (high).

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: one meaningfully persistent route - waxy payload lipid Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #6 early in the list - interacting with cationic guar #9 and glyceryl oleate #8; bounded by an effective SLES/betaine/glucoside reset and the absence of silicone. Claims ('ohne zu beschweren') cannot assign weight (3.2).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: An early waxy lipid plus a cationic polymer make noticeable but bounded residue plausible.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: single persistent route kind with effective reset. Low is the realistic neighbor because rinse-off lipid deposition may be minimal.

focusPrimary.rationale: Moisture: 'Feuchtigkeits-Shampoo' in name, 'für feuchtigkeitsbedürftiges Haar', 'trockenes Haar' claims; verdict moisture_supported via a humectant cluster (Erythritol #11, Glycerin #12, Panthenol #13, Hydrolyzed Hyaluronic Acid #17, Sodium Hyaluronate #18) plus emollient/deposition support (#6, #8, #9) (F1).
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Hyaluronates are late; Piroctone Olamine #15 without anti-dandruff positioning.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind: humectant cluster + lipid/guar -> moisture_supported. Unblind: name 'Feuchtigkeits-Shampoo' -> moisture.

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: 'glänzende Längen' is an outcome of the same route (F2); the dandruff active has no positioning.

usageRole.rationale: Regular: no daily/frequent, reset or problem-led treatment positioning; the recognized active is not positioned, so no treatment trigger.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: positioning is dry hair/lengths; 'sanft zur Kopfhaut' (retailer, brand-level) is mildness, not sensitive-scalp intent.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine #15. Describes the formula only (§11).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate, C moderate: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse acceptable. Ordinary target, no T6. T4: W neighbor low raises fine (no flag), keeps normal ideal; C neighbor high would raise coarse (no flag).
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-DANDRUFF: dandruffSupport supported but no E2 dandruff claim -> no dandruff target; informational active_without_dandruff_positioning. Dry-hair claims are not dry-scalp claims (E2). S-ORDINARY.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular; I3: no neighbor.
projection.liveComparison: Not evaluated (live rows not in sealed packet).

uncertainties: weightPotential low vs moderate turns on how persistent an early 'Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil' is in a rinse-off SLES base; §6 reviewed row only resolves its function (waxy payload lipid), not persistence. Chose moderate (neighbor low).

S-ORDINARY says it applies 'when the product makes no E2 scalp claim at all'; a dandruff-active product without positioning reaches ordinary through S-DANDRUFF's no-target clause rather than S-ORDINARY's literal condition.
